soak.memory_scope: Server OS private bytes and working set sampled every 5 seconds; growth compares six-sample means after 60-second warmup, with max(64 MiB, 25 percent) alarm.
soak.timing_scope: Callback work includes coordination, encoding, ENet enqueue/fan-out and log submission; background log I/O is separate and queue overflow fails acceptance. Wall-clock callback rate and maximum scheduling gap additionally expose stalls outside that work. Outbound bytes count replication payloads, excluding transport overhead and other control RPCs.
